description: Golden fixtures for Dying/Wounded/Doomed condition sequencing (PF2e Remaster).
source: docs/research/13-pf2e-sf2e-mecanicas-nucleo.md §8 — Vida, Morte e Recuperação; specs/17-sistema-pf2e.md REQ-PF2-070..074

keyRules.dying_at_0_hp: Gain Dying 1 (or Dying 2 if caused by crit or critical failure), plus Wounded value added to initial Dying.
keyRules.recovery_check: Flat check DC = 10 + current Dying value; CritSuccess -2, Success -1, Failure +1, CritFailure +2.
keyRules.wounded_on_recovery: Losing Dying condition gains Wounded 1 (or +1 if already Wounded).
keyRules.wounded_stacks_with_dying: When gaining Dying while Wounded X, initial Dying value is (1 + X).
keyRules.doomed_reduces_max: Doomed X reduces max Dying by X; Doomed 1 means death at Dying 3.
keyRules.damage_while_dying: Receiving damage while Dying adds +1 to Dying (+2 if crit).
keyRules.sources: §8.1 Knocked Out, §8.2 Recovery Check, §8.3 Wounded e Progressão; specs/17 REQ-PF2-070..074

cases.description: Reaching 0 HP from normal damage: gain Dying 1
cases.rule: §8.1: 'Quando um personagem chega a 0 HP: Ganha condição Dying 1'

cases.description: Reaching 0 HP from critical hit: gain Dying 2
cases.rule: §8.1: 'Dying 2 se causado por crit ou critical failure'; specs/17 REQ-PF2-070

cases.description: Reaching 0 HP while Wounded 1: initial Dying = 1 + 1 = 2
cases.rule: §8.3: 'Ao ganhar Dying enquanto Wounded X: valor inicial de Dying é Dying (1 + X)'; Wounded 1 → Dying 2

cases.description: Reaching 0 HP from crit while Wounded 2: Dying = 2 + 2 = 4 = death
Recovery check: Critical Success reduces Dying by 2
Recovery check: Success reduces Dying by 1
Recovery check: Failure increases Dying by 1
Recovery check: Critical Failure increases Dying by 2
cases.rule: §8.2: Recovery Check Critical Failure → Dying +2; 2 + 2 = 4 = death

cases.description: Recovery check DC formula: DC = 10 + current Dying value
cases.rule: §8.2: 'flat check (DC = 10 + valor atual de Dying)'; Dying 3 → DC 13

cases.description: Recovering from Dying 1 to Dying 0: lose Dying, gain Wounded 1
cases.rule: §8.3: 'Ao perder o status Dying (qualquer forma): ganha Wounded 1'; specs/17 REQ-PF2-073

cases.description: Recovering from Dying while already Wounded 1: Wounded increases to 2
cases.rule: §8.3: 'ganha Wounded 1 (ou +1 se já tiver)'; Wounded 1 → Wounded 2

cases.description: Receiving damage while Dying: Dying increases by 1
cases.rule: §8.2: 'Receber dano enquanto Dying: +1 ao Dying'; specs/17 REQ-PF2-072

cases.description: Receiving critical damage while Dying: Dying increases by 2
cases.rule: §8.2: 'Receber dano enquanto Dying: +1 ao Dying (+2 se crit)'; specs/17 REQ-PF2-072; 2 + 2 = 4 = death

expected.causeOfDeath: dying reached maxDying (3) due to Doomed 1

cases.rule: §7.6 Doomed: 'Doomed X → máximo de Dying é reduzido por X'; Doomed 1 → maxDying = 3; specs/17 REQ-PF2-074

cases.description: Wounded clears when healed to full HP (with 10 min rest)
cases.rule: §7.6 Wounded: 'encerra com Treat Wounds ou HP cheio + 10 min descanso'
cases.verifyNote: Confirm the engine tracks 'full HP + 10min rest' vs. simple full HP as two distinct triggers for clearing Wounded. Full HP during combat should NOT clear Wounded without the rest.

cases.description: Reaching 0 HP while Wounded 1 from crit: Dying = 2 + 1 = 3
cases.rule: §8.1 + §8.3: crit → base Dying 2; + Wounded 1 = Dying 3 (below max 4, still alive)
